name: S3-compatible Object Storage

permissions.description: HTTPS requests to configured S3 endpoint; AWS SigV4 credentials from named secrets. Optional session token requires explicitly configured secret reference. Mutations require exact confirmation; no retries.

definitions.name: List S3 Buckets (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List S3 Buckets. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/Welcome.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sig-v4-header-based-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sigv4-query-string-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListBuckets.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketLocation.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CreateBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectsV2.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectVersions.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CopyObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketVersioning.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketVersioning.html

Head S3 Bucket. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. definitions.documentation:
Get S3 Bucket Location. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. definitions.documentation:
Create S3 Bucket. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=CREATE_BUCKET and $retries=0. Uncertain actions are never retried. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. definitions.documentation:
List S3 Object Versions. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. definitions.documentation:
Head S3 Object. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/Welcome.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sig-v4-header-based-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sigv4-query-string-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListBuckets.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketLocation.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CreateBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectsV2.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectVersions.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CopyObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketVersioning.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketVersioning.html

definitions.documentation:
Get S3 Object. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/Welcome.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sig-v4-header-based-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sigv4-query-string-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListBuckets.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketLocation.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CreateBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectsV2.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectVersions.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CopyObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketVersioning.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketVersioning.html

definitions.name: Put S3 Object (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Put S3 Object. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=PUT_OBJECT and $retries=0. Uncertain actions are never retried. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/Welcome.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sig-v4-header-based-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sigv4-query-string-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListBuckets.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketLocation.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CreateBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectsV2.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectVersions.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CopyObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketVersioning.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketVersioning.html

definitions.documentation:
Copy S3 Object. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=COPY_OBJECT and $retries=0. Uncertain actions are never retried. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. definitions.documentation:
Delete S3 Object. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=DELETE_OBJECT and $retries=0. Uncertain actions are never retried. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/Welcome.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sig-v4-header-based-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/developerguide/sigv4-query-string-auth.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListBuckets.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketLocation.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CreateBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucket.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectsV2.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_ListObjectVersions.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_HeadObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_CopyObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObject.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteObjectTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_DeleteBucketTagging.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetBucketVersioning.html https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketVersioning.html

Put S3 object Tags. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. definitions.documentation:
Put S3 bucket Tags. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=PUT_BUCKET_TAGS and $retries=0. Uncertain actions are never retried. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. definitions.documentation:
Get S3 Bucket Versioning. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. definitions.documentation:
Set S3 Bucket Versioning. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SET_BUCKET_VERSIONING and $retries=0. Uncertain actions are never retried. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. Presign S3 GET. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. No automatic retries. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported. definitions.documentation:
Presign S3 PUT. Single bounded HTTPS request (presign produces a sensitive capability URL locally). AWS general-purpose S3 REST contract; other S3-compatible implementations are not verified. Max binary 512 KiB; XML/results 1 MiB; max 1000 entries per page; caller follows returned continuation tokens. Credentials use named context.secrets.get references. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=PRESIGN_PUT and $retries=0. Uncertain actions are never retried. Directory buckets, access points, multipart, custom CA configuration and MFA operations are unsupported.
